analysis.purpose: The test suite for tree-sitter-pool — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: grammarsNeededFor (lazy pool — never pay for a grammar a repo never uses); createParserHandle (sync accessor over the async-preloaded pool).
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of tree-sitter-pool
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
